name: @excalidraw/cli
description: Manage Excalidraw workspace resources through the public API and render scenes locally as PNG.

scripts.build: pnpm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/build-renderer.mjs
scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm run typecheck:test && node --test test/integration.test.ts test/features.test.ts test/update.test.ts test/render-validation.test.ts
scripts.test:render: pnpm run build && pnpm run typecheck:test && node --test test/render.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run build && pnpm run typecheck:test && node --test test/e2e.test.ts
